parties.name: Sandisk
parties.note: Named in 2026 as Kioxia's joint venture partner at the Yokkaichi Plant; the two extended their joint venture framework there through December 2034.

summary: The sixth flash memory fab at Kioxia's Yokkaichi Plant in Mie Prefecture, Japan, built as a joint venture with Western Digital; Kioxia's 2026 releases name Sandisk as its Yokkaichi partner. Announced in October 2020, it broke ground in February 2021 and opened in October 2022 after its first construction phase, with a Japanese government subsidy covering part of the cost. It was built for 112-layer and 162-layer flash, with output ramping in stages. Kioxia's 2025 integrated report says Fab7 started operation in October 2022, and a December 2025 Kioxia release describes wafer processing in the fab.

metrics.note: Expected total for the first phase.

milestones.note: Target of spring 2022 for the first phase.
The April and July 2022 releases report the first construction phase as finished.

notes: Kioxia planned Fab7 in two construction phases so production could continue during the work. The cited sources describe only the first phase; none, including Kioxia's 2025 integrated report, its December 2025 release and the August 2026 Kioxia and Sandisk investment release, reports the start or completion of a second phase. No investment figure covering the whole fab, including a second phase, has been published. The integrated report gives no publication date beyond its fiscal 2024 reporting year; it mentions events of September 2025, so it is dated 2025.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Added the 2026 Kioxia and Sandisk release to record Sandisk as the current Yokkaichi joint venture partner, and cited the April and July 2022 releases for the completed first construction phase. Audit fixes (2026-11-07): added Kioxia's December 2025 release on a filmed tour of Fab7's production lines and the Kioxia Holdings 2025 integrated report, which says Fab7 started operation in October 2022, to support the operating status (status_as_of moved from 2022-10-26 to 2025-12-18); neither reports a second construction phase.
